verdict.rationale: Grafana's provisioning-as-code, CLI, and API/OpenAPI capabilities (grafana-docs-2/3/11/16/26/31, grafana-probe-3/5) let users define and manage many dashboards, data sources, and alerts programmatically, and the MCP server (grafana-probe-4, grafana-docs-7) lets AI agents interact with these APIs. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk-edit/bulk-action UI or API endpoint for operating on many alerts/dashboards simultaneously in one call. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-update/bulk-delete API examples, evidence of an AI agent actually performing bulk operations end-to-end, and independent confirmation of scale/performance for bulk actions.
